title: Fail closed on unreadable local-worker claims
summary: Fail closed when an existing local-worker claim authority cannot be read or validated, preserving duplicate-work protection until explicit recovery.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-W03-007. The local-worker claim loader converts any read or JSON failure into a fresh empty store, allowing a second worker to claim a source whose existing ownership evidence became unreadable.
behavior_before: Missing, corrupt, unreadable, wrong-schema, and structurally invalid claim authority all converge on an empty store, so synchronized claim decisions can still admit duplicate work after authority loss.
behavior_after: Only a genuinely missing store initializes empty. Existing stores must be readable current-schema objects with an array of internally consistent current-schema claims; every untrusted store blocks mutation with a stable recovery error while preserving its bytes.
tests_added: Malformed JSON, locked-file read failure, wrong-schema/root, non-array claims, and invalid claim-record fixtures prove admission fails closed with stable errors and byte preservation.
Two independent worker processes contend for the same source and persist exactly one winning claim.
